subject: th-cont
title: TH.CONT-----C.INFO.
description: Chart on book p. 137 (T(AF)M-41). TH-CONT (thrust continuance) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; C-INFO (composite information) is the partner. From the subject: MT-INFO (multi-information), with the (C) prefix, "the concept of". From C-INFO: MT-IF-DB (multi-informational degree basis) and RT-T. From MT-INFO: C-INFO and PRI-INFO (principle information).
